rv.q: That production was full of good things, but it pales beside the blazing brilliance and energy of this revival, directed by Ian Rickson.

This stylish and welcome revival of his 2001 play, The Goat, or Who is Sylvia? is his second to open in the West End since his death last year and further demonstrates his unique skill at knowing exactly how to manipulate and test his audience.
Okonedo's ratcheting up from disbelief through anger and resolution describes a steady shuddering arc. It's electrifying...
Edward Albee’s 2002 play is only on its first UK revival, and perhaps this is understandable as the audience for a black tragi-comedy about bestiality may be rather specialised.
